\subsubsection{Smart Defaults and Error Messages}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:smart-defaults-and-error-messages}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The DSL includes \sphinxstylestrong{smart defaults} that automatically compute commonly used centrality metrics when referenced but not explicitly computed. This feature makes queries more ergonomic while maintaining predictable behavior.


\paragraph{Auto\sphinxhyphen{}Computing Centrality Metrics}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:auto-computing-centrality-metrics}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
When you reference a centrality metric in operations like \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{top\_k()}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{order\_by()}}, or other ranking operations, the DSL will automatically compute it if not already present:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} The DSL auto\PYGZhy{}computes betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality when needed}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Auto\PYGZhy{}computed here}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality column is available even though}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} we didn\PYGZsq{}t explicitly call .compute(\PYGZdq{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality\PYGZdq{})}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Supported centrality aliases:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{degree}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{degree\_centrality}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{betweenness}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{betweenness\_centrality}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{closeness}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{closeness\_centrality}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{eigenvector}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{eigenvector\_centrality}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pagerank}}

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{When auto\sphinxhyphen{}compute happens:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
When the attribute is referenced in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{top\_k()}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
When the attribute is used in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{order\_by()}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For both per\sphinxhyphen{}group (with grouping) and global operations

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Example with multiple auto\sphinxhyphen{}computed metrics:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Auto\PYGZhy{}compute degree for filtering and betweenness for ranking}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} degree auto\PYGZhy{}computed here}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{desc}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} betweenness auto\PYGZhy{}computed here}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{Controlling Autocompute Behavior}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:controlling-autocompute-behavior}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
You can explicitly control whether metrics are automatically computed using the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{autocompute}} parameter:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Disable autocompute \PYGZhy{} require explicit .compute() calls}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{autocompute}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Autocompute disabled}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Must explicitly compute}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} This would raise DslMissingMetricError because betweenness is not computed:}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Q.nodes(autocompute=False).order\PYGZus{}by(\PYGZdq{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality\PYGZdq{}).execute(net)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{When to disable autocompute:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Performance\sphinxhyphen{}critical code}: Avoid unexpected expensive computations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Explicit control}: Make all metric computations visible in code

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Debugging}: Understand exactly which metrics are computed and when

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Tracking computed metrics:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Query results include a \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{computed\_metrics}} attribute that tracks which metrics were computed during execution:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Auto\PYGZhy{}computed}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Check which metrics were computed}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Computed metrics: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{computed\PYGZus{}metrics}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Output: Computed metrics: \PYGZob{}\PYGZsq{}degree\PYGZsq{}, \PYGZsq{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality\PYGZsq{}\PYGZcb{}}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use cases for computed\_metrics:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Performance profiling: identify expensive operations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Query optimization: avoid redundant computations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Debugging: verify expected metrics were computed

\end{itemize}

            \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Typo: \PYGZdq{}betweness\PYGZdq{} instead of \PYGZdq{}betweenness\PYGZdq{}}

Some operations require \sphinxstylestrong{active grouping} (via \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{per\_layer()}} or \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{group\_by()}}). The DSL raises \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{GroupingError}} with clear guidance when these operations are used incorrectly:

        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{k}{except} \PYG{n}{GroupingError} \PYG{k}{as} \PYG{n}{e}\PYG{p}{:}

     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{coverage}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{mode}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{all}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Now works correctly}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{When Smart Defaults DON’T Apply}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:when-smart-defaults-don-t-apply}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Smart defaults are \sphinxstylestrong{predictable and conservative}. They only apply in specific scenarios:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Only for centrality metrics}: Smart defaults work for recognized centrality metrics (degree, betweenness, etc.), not arbitrary attributes.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Explicit compute takes precedence}: If you explicitly compute a metric, the DSL uses your computation and doesn’t auto\sphinxhyphen{}compute:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Explicit compute \PYGZhy{} no auto\PYGZhy{}compute happens}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Explicit}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Uses explicit computation}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Edge attributes are not auto\sphinxhyphen{}computed}: For edge queries, attributes like \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{weight}} are read from edge data, not auto\sphinxhyphen{}computed:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edge weight is read from edge data, not computed}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{weight}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Uses edge data[\PYGZsq{}weight\PYGZsq{}]}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\end{enumerate}


\paragraph{Benefits of Smart Defaults}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:benefits-of-smart-defaults}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Ergonomics}: Write less boilerplate for common patterns:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Before smart defaults (verbose)}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{closeness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} With smart defaults (concise)}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{per\PYGZus{}layer}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
        \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{top\PYGZus{}k}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Auto\PYGZhy{}computes what\PYGZsq{}s needed}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}grouping}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Teaching errors}: When something goes wrong, you get actionable guidance instead of cryptic messages.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Predictability}: Smart defaults only activate for well\sphinxhyphen{}known patterns. Your explicit operations always take precedence.


\subsubsection{Temporal Queries}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:temporal-queries}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The DSL supports temporal filtering for networks with time\sphinxhyphen{}stamped edges or nodes. Four convenience methods provide intuitive temporal filtering: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.at(t)}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.during(t0, t1)}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.before(t)}}, and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.after(t)}}.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Prerequisites for temporal queries:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Edges or nodes must have temporal attributes:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Point\sphinxhyphen{}in\sphinxhyphen{}time}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t}} attribute (e.g., \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\{"t": 150.0\}}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Intervals}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t\_start}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t\_end}} attributes (e.g., \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{\{"t\_start": 100.0, "t\_end": 200.0\}}})

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Time values are typically numeric (timestamps) or ISO date strings

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Detailed semantics:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{at(t)}}: Selects entities active at a specific moment
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For point\sphinxhyphen{}in\sphinxhyphen{}time edges: includes edges where \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t\_edge == t}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For interval edges: includes edges where \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t}} is in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{{[}t\_start, t\_end{]}}}

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{during(t0, t1)}}: Selects entities active during a time window
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For point\sphinxhyphen{}in\sphinxhyphen{}time edges: includes edges where \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t}} is in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{{[}t0, t1{]}}} (closed interval)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For interval edges: includes edges where the interval \sphinxstylestrong{overlaps} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{{[}t0, t1{]}}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{None}} values: Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t0=None}} for open lower bound, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t1=None}} for open upper bound

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{before(t)}}: Selects entities active before (and at) time t
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Convenience method equivalent to \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.during(None, t)}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Inclusive of the boundary: includes entities at exactly time t

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{after(t)}}: Selects entities active after (and at) time t
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Convenience method equivalent to \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.during(t, None)}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Inclusive of the boundary: includes entities at exactly time t

\end{itemize}

\end{itemize}

\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:filter-by-time-snapshot}}

Query the network state at a specific point in time:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]

     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Nodes active at t=150: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Average degree at t=150: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Top nodes by degree at this snapshot:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nlargest}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Nodes active during [100, 200]: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Nodes at t=150 (snapshot): }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{snapshot\PYGZus{}result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Ratio: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{o}{/}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{snapshot\PYGZus{}result}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{x more nodes in range}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output:}

Nodes at t=150 (snapshot): 78
Ratio: 1.82x more nodes in range
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\paragraph{Before and After (Convenience Methods)}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:before-and-after-convenience-methods}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.before()}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.after()}} methods provide intuitive alternatives for open\sphinxhyphen{}ended temporal queries:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get all edges before time 100 (inclusive)}
\PYG{n}{early\PYGZus{}edges} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{before}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{100.0}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Get all edges after time 200 (inclusive)}
\PYG{n}{late\PYGZus{}edges} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{after}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{200.0}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Common pattern: compare network before and after an event}
\PYG{n}{event\PYGZus{}time} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{l+m+mf}{150.0}

\PYG{n}{before\PYGZus{}event} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{before}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{event\PYGZus{}time}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{after\PYGZus{}event} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{after}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{event\PYGZus{}time}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Compare metrics}
\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}before} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{before\PYGZus{}event}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}after} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{after\PYGZus{}event}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Average degree before event: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}before}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Average degree after event: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}after}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Network became }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{denser}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{if}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}after}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n}{df\PYGZus{}before}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{else}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{sparser}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
Average degree before event: 4.35
Average degree after event: 5.87
Network became denser
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Temporal edges example:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edges active during a period}
\PYG{n}{edges} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{during}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mf}{100.0}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mf}{200.0}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{edge\PYGZus{}betweenness}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{edges}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Active edges during [100, 200]: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Mean edge betweenness: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{edge\PYGZus{}betweenness}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.4f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Note on implementation status:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Temporal queries are \sphinxstylestrong{fully implemented} for edge\sphinxhyphen{}level temporal data. Node\sphinxhyphen{}level temporal filtering depends on your network’s representation:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
If nodes have explicit \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{t}} attributes, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.at()}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.during()}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.before()}}, and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.after()}} work directly

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
If only edges are timestamped, node activity is inferred from edge presence

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
For most use cases, temporal edge queries are sufficient

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{DSL Reference}}}} for complete temporal query syntax and examples with ISO date strings.


\subsubsection{Common Patterns}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:common-patterns}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This section presents \sphinxstylestrong{end\sphinxhyphen{}to\sphinxhyphen{}end recipes} for common multilayer network analysis tasks. These patterns are production\sphinxhyphen{}ready and can be adapted to your research questions.


\paragraph{Pattern: Find Influential Nodes}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:pattern-find-influential-nodes}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Identify nodes that are both well\sphinxhyphen{}connected (high degree) and structurally important (high betweenness centrality):

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} High\PYGZhy{}degree nodes ranked by betweenness centrality}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer\PYGZus{}count}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{20}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Top 20 influential nodes (degree \PYGZgt{} 10):}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{id}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer\PYGZus{}count}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export for further analysis or publication}
\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}csv}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{influential\PYGZus{}nodes.csv}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{index}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Visualize}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{matplotlib}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{pyplot}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{plt}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{figure}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{figsize}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{6}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{scatter}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}
            \PYG{n}{s}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer\PYGZus{}count}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{l+m+mi}{50}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{alpha}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.6}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{xlabel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{ylabel}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Betweenness Centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{title}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Influential Nodes (size = layer\PYGZus{}count)}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{tight\PYGZus{}layout}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{savefig}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{influential\PYGZus{}nodes.png}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dpi}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{300}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Why this pattern works:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Degree} measures local connectivity (how many neighbors)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Betweenness centrality} measures global importance (how often the node appears on shortest paths)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Nodes high in both metrics are \sphinxstylestrong{influential bridges} in the network

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Expected output:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
Top 20 influential nodes (degree \PYGZgt{} 10):
                   id  degree  betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality  layer\PYGZus{}count
0     (eve, social)      15                 0.301000            3
1   (alice, social)      12                 0.245000            2
2   (grace, social)      11                 0.221000            2
3     (bob, social)      12                 0.198000            1
4   (diana, work)        14                 0.187000            3
...

\paragraph{Pattern: Compare Layer Activity}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:pattern-compare-layer-activity}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Compute summary statistics for each layer to understand layer\sphinxhyphen{}specific dynamics:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{layers} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{get\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}stats} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{layer} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{append}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{num\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{max\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{max}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
        \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean\PYGZus{}clustering}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}

    \PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ nodes, }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
          \PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{avg degree=}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{, }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
          \PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{avg clustering=}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.3f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create comparison DataFrame}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{pandas}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{pd}
\PYG{n}{comparison} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{pd}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{DataFrame}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Layer comparison:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{comparison}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Visualize}
\PYG{n}{comparison}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{plot}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{x}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{layer}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{y}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean\PYGZus{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean\PYGZus{}clustering}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{,}

\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{title}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Layer Activity Comparison}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{xticks}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{rotation}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{45}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{tight\PYGZus{}layout}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{savefig}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{layer\PYGZus{}comparison.png}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dpi}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{300}\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{Pattern: Export Subnetwork}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:pattern-export-subnetwork}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Extract a subnetwork based on query criteria for focused analysis or visualization:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Extract high\PYGZhy{}activity multilayer nodes}
\PYG{n}{active\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}count\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Selected }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{active\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ multilayer nodes}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create subnetwork containing only these nodes}
\PYG{n}{subnetwork} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{subgraph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{active\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{keys}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Subnetwork: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{subnetwork}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{number\PYGZus{}of\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ nodes, }\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}
      \PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{subnetwork}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{number\PYGZus{}of\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ edges}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Analyze subnetwork}
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{active\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+se}{\PYGZbs{}n}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Subnetwork mean degree: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.2f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Subnetwork mean betweenness: }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{mean}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{:}\PYG{l+s+s2}{.4f}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export for visualization or further analysis}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{visualization}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{matplotlib}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{pyplot}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{plt}

\PYG{n}{fig}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{ax} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{subplots}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{figsize}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{12}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{subnetwork}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{ax}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{ax}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{display}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{savefig}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{subnetwork\PYGZus{}viz.png}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dpi}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{300}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{close}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Or export in various formats}
\PYG{n}{subnetwork}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{save\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{subnetwork.edgelist}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{output\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{edgelist}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

    \PYG{n}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.1}
\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

This pattern is often combined with community detection, dynamics simulation, or centrality analysis:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 1. Select subnetwork}
\PYG{n}{core\PYGZus{}nodes} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}count\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gte}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{subnetwork} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{subgraph}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{core\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{keys}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 2. Run community detection on subnetwork}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{algorithms}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{community\PYGZus{}detection}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{community\PYGZus{}wrapper}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{louvain\PYGZus{}communities}
\PYG{n}{communities} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{louvain\PYGZus{}communities}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{subnetwork}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 3. Analyze communities}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Found }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n+nb}{len}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n+nb}{set}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{communities}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{values}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ communities}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 4. Visualize or export}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{visualization}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}
\PYG{k+kn}{import}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{matplotlib}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{pyplot}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k}{as}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{plt}

\PYG{n}{fig}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{ax} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{subplots}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{figsize}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{12}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Note: communities dict can be used for node coloring if the visualization function supports it}
\PYG{n}{draw\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}default}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{subnetwork}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{ax}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{ax}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{display}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{savefig}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{core\PYGZus{}network\PYGZus{}communities.png}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{dpi}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{300}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{plt}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{close}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\paragraph{Pattern: Per\sphinxhyphen{}Layer Top\sphinxhyphen{}K with Coverage (Multi\sphinxhyphen{}Layer Hub Detection)}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:pattern-per-layer-top-k-with-coverage-multi-layer-hub-detection}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Find nodes that are top\sphinxhyphen{}k hubs (by any centrality metric) \sphinxstylestrong{across all layers}. This pattern is essential for identifying nodes that maintain high influence in the entire multilayer structure, not just in isolated layers.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{The Problem:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Traditional approaches require manual loops over layers:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Old approach: manual iteration}
\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}top} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}
\PYG{k}{for} \PYG{n}{layer} \PYG{o+ow}{in} \PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{layers}\PYG{p}{:}
    \PYG{n}{res} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
        \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n+nb}{str}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{5}\PYG{p}{)}
         \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{p}{)}
    \PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}top}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{set}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{res}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{id}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Find intersection}
\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}hubs} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n+nb}{set}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{intersection}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{o}{*}\PYG{n}{layer\PYGZus{}top}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{values}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{The Solution: Grouping and Coverage API}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The new DSL supports per\sphinxhyphen{}layer operations in a single query:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{random\PYGZus{}generators}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Generate example network}
\PYG{n}{net} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{random\PYGZus{}generators}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{random\PYGZus{}multilayer\PYGZus{}ER}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{n}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{200}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{l}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{p}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{0.05}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Find nodes that are top\PYGZhy{}5 betweenness hubs in ALL layers (single query!)}
\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}hubs} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{*}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}                   \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} wildcard: all layers}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use Cases:}
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Identify persistent influencers}: Nodes that maintain high centrality across all contexts (layers)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Find layer specialists}: Nodes that are important in only one layer (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{mode="exact", k=1}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Detect multi\sphinxhyphen{}context bridges}: Nodes in top\sphinxhyphen{}k in at least 2 layers connect different contexts

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Community structure analysis}: Compare \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{mode="all"}} vs \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{mode="any"}} to understand layer cohesion

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Why This Pattern Matters:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
In real\sphinxhyphen{}world multilayer networks (social media, collaboration networks, biological systems), understanding \sphinxstylestrong{cross\sphinxhyphen{}layer} vs. \sphinxstylestrong{layer\sphinxhyphen{}specific} importance is crucial:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Email + Phone + Chat network}: Who are the omnipresent communicators vs. email\sphinxhyphen{}only specialists?

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Author collaboration network}: Who publishes top papers in multiple fields vs. specialists in one domain?

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Transportation network}: Which locations are hubs in all modes (bus, train, bike) vs. single\sphinxhyphen{}mode hubs?

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Performance Note:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The per\sphinxhyphen{}layer computation is optimized: measures are computed on the selected nodes after layer filtering, and grouping operations leverage efficient dictionaries. For large networks (\textgreater{}100K nodes), consider filtering with \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{where()}} before computing expensive metrics like betweenness centrality.


\subsubsection{DSL Result Interoperability}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:dsl-result-interoperability}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
DSL query results integrate seamlessly with pandas for data transformation workflows. While QueryResult doesn’t implement pipeline verbs directly, it provides a clean \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.to\_pandas()}} export that enables the same workflow patterns:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Start with a DSL query to filter and compute metrics

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Export to pandas with \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.to\_pandas()}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use pandas operations for additional transformations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Leverage the full pandas ecosystem for analysis and visualization

\end{enumerate}


\paragraph{QueryResult to pandas Workflow}

A realistic workflow combining both DSL and pandas operations:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{L}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Scenario: Find influential nodes in social network, normalize scores,}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}           rank within communities, export for visualization}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} DSL: Query and compute graph metrics}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{from\PYGZus{}layers}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{L}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Export to pandas for transformations}
\PYG{n}{df} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} pandas: Transform and enhance data}
\PYG{n}{max\PYGZus{}betweenness} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{max}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Normalize centrality to [0, 1]}
\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{norm\PYGZus{}betweenness}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{/} \PYG{n}{max\PYGZus{}betweenness}
    \PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n}{max\PYGZus{}betweenness} \PYG{o}{\PYGZgt{}} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0} \PYG{k}{else} \PYG{l+m+mi}{0}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Composite influence score}
\PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{influence}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.5} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{degree}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{+}
    \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.3} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{norm\PYGZus{}betweenness}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]} \PYG{o}{+}
    \PYG{l+m+mf}{0.2} \PYG{o}{*} \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}} \PYG{n}{df}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{clustering}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Group by community and compute statistics}

    \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{influence}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{count}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{max}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{round}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Sort communities by average influence}

    \PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{influence}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{mean}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{n}{ascending}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{community\PYGZus{}stats}\PYG{p}{)}

\sphinxstylestrong{Why this matters:}
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Single pipeline}: No need to export intermediate results to disk or juggle multiple DataFrames

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Flexibility}: DSL for graph operations, pandas for everything else

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Performance}: DSL computes centrality on the multilayer graph once, pandas transforms in\sphinxhyphen{}memory

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Ecosystem}: Full pandas ecosystem available (plotting, statistics, export formats)

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{When to use each:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{DSL alone}: Simple queries, need graph\sphinxhyphen{}specific operations (centrality, grouping, coverage)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{pandas alone}: Non\sphinxhyphen{}graph data, pure data transformations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Combined (DSL \(\rightarrow\) pandas)}: Complex analytical workflows, need both graph metrics and custom computations

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{how-to/build_pipelines::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{How to Build Analysis Pipelines with Dplyr\sphinxhyphen{}style Operations}}}} for the dplyr\sphinxhyphen{}style pipeline API (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{nodes()}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{edges()}} functions) which provides an alternative approach using chainable operations directly on networks.


\subsubsection{Next Steps}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:next-steps}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Now that you understand the DSL, explore these related resources:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{DSL Reference} ({\hyperref[\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{DSL Reference}}}}): Complete grammar, all operators, full list of built\sphinxhyphen{}in measures, and advanced features (EXPLAIN queries, parameter binding, custom operators)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Dplyr\sphinxhyphen{}Style Pipelines} ({\hyperref[\detokenize{how-to/build_pipelines::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{How to Build Analysis Pipelines with Dplyr\sphinxhyphen{}style Operations}}}}): Combine DSL queries with pipeline operations for more complex data transformation workflows. The pipeline API (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{nodes()}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{mutate()}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{arrange()}}) complements the DSL for when you need procedural transformations.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Community Detection} ({\hyperref[\detokenize{how-to/run_community_detection::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{How to Run Community Detection on Multilayer Networks}}}}): Use DSL queries to select nodes, then apply community detection algorithms. Pattern: query \(\rightarrow\) detect communities \(\rightarrow\) analyze community structure.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Network Dynamics} ({\hyperref[\detokenize{how-to/simulate_dynamics::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{How to Simulate Multilayer Dynamics}}}}): Run dynamics simulations on DSL\sphinxhyphen{}selected subnetworks. Pattern: query \(\rightarrow\) extract subnetwork \(\rightarrow\) simulate \(\rightarrow\) analyze outcomes.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Linting and Validation} ({\hyperref[\detokenize{reference/dsl_reference::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{DSL Reference}}}}): The DSL includes a linting subsystem (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{py3plex dsl\sphinxhyphen{}lint}}) that checks queries for errors, performance issues, and suggests optimizations. Use it to validate complex queries.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Examples Repository} ({\hyperref[\detokenize{examples/index::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{Examples \& Recipes}}}}): Full scripts showing DSL in context, including data loading, query composition, analysis, and visualization.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Key Takeaways:}
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Use the builder API} (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Q}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L}}) for production code—it’s type\sphinxhyphen{}safe, refactorable, and IDE\sphinxhyphen{}friendly.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Filter early}: Add \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{where()}} clauses before \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{compute()}} for better performance on large networks.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Embrace pandas}: Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.to\_pandas()}} for result analysis—it integrates seamlessly with the scientific Python stack.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Layer algebra is powerful}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L{[}"a"{]} + L{[}"b"{]}}} (union), \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{L{[}"a"{]} \& L{[}"b"{]}}} (intersection) enable sophisticated multilayer queries.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Temporal queries} require timestamped edges/nodes but unlock time\sphinxhyphen{}series network analysis.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Query optimization}: When ordering by existing attributes with LIMIT, the DSL automatically applies the limit early to reduce computation on expensive measures.

\end{enumerate}


\paragraph{Automatic Query Optimization}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl:automatic-query-optimization}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The DSL automatically optimizes query execution order to minimize computation:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Early LIMIT Optimization:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
When your query includes:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
A \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{LIMIT}} clause

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
An \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ORDER BY}} clause

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{COMPUTE}} operations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Ordering by an \sphinxstylestrong{existing} attribute (not being computed)

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The executor applies \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ORDER BY}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{LIMIT}} \sphinxstylestrong{before} computing expensive measures, dramatically reducing computation time.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Example:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Find top 10 highest\PYGZhy{}degree nodes, then compute betweenness}
\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness\PYGZus{}centrality}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Expensive operation}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}degree}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}                \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Degree already exists}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Optimized execution:}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 1. Order all nodes by degree (fast \PYGZhy{} degree already available)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 2. Take top 10 nodes (reduces set size)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} 3. Compute betweenness on those 10 nodes only (huge speedup!)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Without optimization:} Computes betweenness on all nodes, then takes top 10.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{With optimization:} Takes top 10 by degree first, then computes betweenness on only those 10 nodes.

\sphinxAtStartPar
For networks with 1000+ nodes, this can provide \sphinxstylestrong{100x speedup} when computing expensive centrality measures.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{When optimization does NOT apply:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Ordering by a computed attribute (must compute all first):

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Must compute betweenness on all nodes to find top 10}
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{compute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{betweenness}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{order\PYGZus{}by}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZhy{}betweenness}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{limit}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+m+mi}{10}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
No ORDER BY clause (limit is arbitrary)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Grouping is active (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{per\_layer()}} uses per\sphinxhyphen{}group limits)

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Best practices for performance:}
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use existing attributes for ordering when possible (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{degree}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{layer}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Apply \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{where()}} filters early to reduce dataset size

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Order by pre\sphinxhyphen{}computed attributes before computing expensive measures

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{per\_layer().top\_k()}} for efficient per\sphinxhyphen{}layer operations

\end{enumerate}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Community and Support:}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Report issues or request features: \sphinxurl{https://github.com/SkBlaz/py3plex/issues}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Example notebooks: \sphinxurl{https://github.com/SkBlaz/py3plex/tree/main/examples}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
py3plex documentation: \sphinxurl{https://skblaz.github.io/py3plex/}

\end{itemize}

\subsection{How to Find Graph Patterns and Motifs with the Pattern Matching API}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_patterns:how-to-find-graph-patterns-and-motifs-with-the-pattern-matching-api}}\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_patterns::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Goal:} Use py3plex’s Pattern Matching Builder API to find graph motifs, paths, triangles, and complex subgraph patterns in multilayer networks.

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{🎯 What You’ll Learn}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
How to express graph patterns using the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Q.pattern()}} builder API

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
How to match edges, paths, triangles, and custom motifs

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
How to apply multilayer\sphinxhyphen{}aware constraints (within/between layers)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
How to filter patterns using node and edge predicates

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
How to extract and analyze pattern match results

\end{itemize}
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{💻 Complete Example}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See the full executable example: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{example\_pattern\_matching.py}}
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Prerequisites:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
A loaded \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{multi\_layer\_network}} object (see {\hyperref[\detokenize{how-to/load_and_build_networks::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{How to Load and Build Networks}}}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Basic familiarity with the DSL (see {\hyperref[\detokenize{how-to/query_with_dsl::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{How to Query Multilayer Graphs with the SQL\sphinxhyphen{}like DSL}}}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Understanding of graph motifs (edges, paths, triangles, subgraphs)

\end{itemize}


\subsubsection{Why Pattern Matching?}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_patterns:why-pattern-matching}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Pattern matching allows you to find \sphinxstylestrong{specific subgraph structures} in your network. Unlike node/edge queries that return individual elements, pattern matching returns \sphinxstylestrong{complete matches} where multiple nodes and edges satisfy structural constraints.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Common Use Cases:}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Motif Detection:} Find triangles, cliques, or other structural patterns

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Path Analysis:} Discover multi\sphinxhyphen{}hop connections between nodes

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Multilayer Patterns:} Identify cross\sphinxhyphen{}layer relationships

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Complex Queries:} Express “find nodes A, B, C where A connects to B with weight \textgreater{} 0.5, B connects to C, and all are in the social layer”

\end{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Comparison to Basic Queries:}


\subsubsection{Quick Start: Your First Pattern}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_patterns:quick-start-your-first-pattern}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Let’s start with a simple example: finding all edges in a network.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Mental model:} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Q.pattern()}} binds \sphinxstylestrong{variables} (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{"a"}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{"b"}}, etc.) to actual node\sphinxhyphen{}layer tuples, then checks that every required edge or path between those variables exists. Each match is a complete mapping of variables \(\rightarrow\) node\sphinxhyphen{}layer tuples rather than a single node or edge.

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{core}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{multinet}
\PYG{k+kn}{from}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nn}{py3plex}\PYG{n+nn}{.}\PYG{n+nn}{dsl}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{k+kn}{import} \PYG{n}{Q}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create a simple network}
\PYG{n}{network} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{multinet}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{multi\PYGZus{}layer\PYGZus{}network}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}nodes}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Charlie}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{,}
\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{add\PYGZus{}edges}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{[}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Alice}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
     \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{weight}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{,}
    \PYG{p}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Bob}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{Charlie}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,}
     \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{source\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{target\PYGZus{}type}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{social}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{weight}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{:} \PYG{l+m+mf}{2.0}\PYG{p}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{p}{,}
\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Find all edges (simple pattern)}
\PYG{n}{pattern} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{p}{(}
    \PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{pattern}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}              \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Define node variable \PYGZdq{}a\PYGZdq{}}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{b}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}              \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Define node variable \PYGZdq{}b\PYGZdq{}}
     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{b}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}         \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Require edge between a and b}
\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{n}{result} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{pattern}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{execute}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{network}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+sa}{f}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{Found }\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZob{}}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{count}\PYG{l+s+si}{\PYGZcb{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{ matches}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{result}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{to\PYGZus{}pandas}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Output:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
Found 4 matches
                 a                  b
0  (Alice, social)      (Bob, social)
1    (Bob, social)    (Alice, social)
2    (Bob, social)  (Charlie, social)
3  (Charlie, social)    (Bob, social)
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Notice that undirected edges produce matches in both directions.


\subsubsection{Pattern Components}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_patterns:pattern-components}}

\paragraph{Nodes}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_patterns:nodes}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Define node variables that will be bound to actual nodes during matching:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Simple node}
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{pattern}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Node with semantic labels (metadata only)}
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{pattern}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{labels}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{person}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Node with predicates}
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{pattern}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{degree\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mi}{3}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Node with layer constraint}
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{pattern}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{node}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{layer}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{social}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Node Predicates:}

\sphinxAtStartPar
All standard DSL predicates work with pattern nodes:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{degree\_\_gt=5}} — degree greater than 5

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{degree\_\_lt=2}} — degree less than 2

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{layer="social"}} — node must be in social layer

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Any node attribute: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{age\_\_gt=30}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{type="user"}}, etc.

\end{itemize}


\paragraph{Edges}
\label{\detokenize{how-to/query_with_patterns:edges}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Define edges between node variables:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Undirected edge}
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{pattern}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{b}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Directed edge}
\PYG{n}{Q}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{pattern}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{b}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{directed}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Edge with predicates}

     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{b}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{p}{)}

     \PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{edge}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{c}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{a}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{where}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{weight\PYGZus{}\PYGZus{}gt}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{l+m+mf}{1.0}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{p}{)}
